Lena (Docs): Pushed a patch to the Dedicated capacity guide that adds an "overflow routing" recipe: shows how traffic can degrade to a quantized model and includes a short migration note for the SDK rename we discussed last sprint. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812

Carlos (Eng-Platform): Thanks. Can you paste the routing YAML and both JS/Python SDK examples here so I can run the docs linkchecker and a quick smoke build against the site? Also which anchors did you add/rename?

Lena (Docs): Routing YAML (minimal):
```yaml
traffic_routing:
  order: [latency, cost_tier]
  overflow:
    - model: rdm-quant-v1
      trigger: high_queue_length
      note: "quantized fallback to preserve latency SLOs"
```
JS SDK example:
```js
// client is Redwood SDK instance
await client.routes.create({
  model: 'rdm-large-v2',
  tenant_label: 'org-17',
  routing: { strategy: 'overflow_first' }
});
```
Python SDK example:
```py
# prefer explicit keywords for types
client.routes.create(model='rdm-large-v2', tenant_label='org-17', routing={'strategy':'overflow_first'})
```
I added anchors: #overflow-routing and #operational-pinning. Replaced old anchor #fallbacks in a few crosslinks.

Priya (Product): Quick product note: wording around "preserve latency SLOs" is ok but avoid implying we won't evict reserved capacity. Maybe add a sentence: "Reserved pools with pinned models are not subject to overflow routing."

Ethan (Eng-SRE): Also add a tiny example of the Dedicated config for pinning during scheduled peak windows. Something like:
```yaml
reserved_pools:
  - name: peak-windows
    models: ['rdm-large-v2']
    schedule: 'weekdays: 08:00-20:00'
```
That helps ops and customers see the avoidance pattern.

Carlos (Eng-Platform): Running linkcheck now. Heads up: we still have one stale reference to `tenant_hint` in docs/api-reference/routes.md. I'll push a commit to the PR to update that to `tenant_label` and add a short migration sidebar.

Lena (Docs): Thanks Carlos. I added a short migration note under "Upgrading SDKs" but happy to fold your sidebar change in. Also updated the handbook TOC to include Operational pinning section.

Carlos (Eng-Platform): Local linkcheck shows two heading duplicates where your new anchors landed under similar headings; I adjusted the heading slugs and updated internal refs in the same PR. Build warning: markdown-lint flagged an unordered list indentation in the operational section. I fixed it.

Priya (Product): LGTM on the content changes. Suggest one more copy edit on the migration note: change "maps from tenant_hint" to "if you previously used tenant_hint, set tenant_label to the same value" — clearer for customers.

Lena (Docs): Good wording; updated. Thanks everyone. I'll merge after CI shows green. I'll follow up with a small PR adding more examples for telemetry tagging and a short snippet showing a migration helper script for Python.

Ethan (Eng-SRE): Thanks. Optional: add a one-line pointer to our incident runbook where overflow routing should be part of mitigation steps.

Lena (Docs): Will add the pointer in the follow-up.
